format_boundary: Review views over existing contracts; not a new runtime schema, global registry, or Canonical Store.

step4_prerequisite.accepted_effect_boundary: Reuse the existing scoped Step4 administrative acceptance; this candidate issues no new acceptance, runtime authority or Freeze.

locator_boundary: Evidence locator only, not a newly minted Canonical CopyID or a replacement of an existing embedded object ID.
rules: Preserve existing embedded object IDs, revision references, source signatures and receipt IDs in exact-byte copies.
Retain each distinct occurrence/path/container in evidence even when its content digest matches another occurrence.
Same digest establishes byte equality only; logical equivalence and source lineage require the existing manifest/provenance binding.
A mirror is not independently writable, resignable, accepted or authoritative merely because it is copied into this repository.
If an actual future copy operation needs a receipt or copy identity, its owning typed contract must bind source and destination/occurrence; no runtime copy operation is performed in this preparation.
Copy/representation divergence invalidates relevant digest/projection checks; it does not authorize overwriting either history or the Canonical source.
